headline: 5-3, 3rd, and a promise kept
story: Week 8 was the Match of the Week and a 124.02 to 67.46 win over Darkspaces, a margin of 56.56. Mike Gesicki led at 17.6 and 28.62 stayed on a 57.36-point bench, including the Buccaneers defense at 18. He is 5-3, still 3rd, with 1101.58 points, 3rd in the league.

The feud with Darkspaces paid out in the chat and on the scoreboard. He added Ryan Flournoy and the Buccaneers defense for free and holds $330 of FAAB. His 1332.36 MAXPF is the third-highest and moves him from the 1.11 to the 1.10, with Painty69's 1339.8 now at the 1.11.
takes: Promised to out score the commissioner, and did by 56.56.
A win with 28.62 on the bench is still a win.
